JSON 转换：全部可用目标JSON conversions: every available target

JSON 的麻烦不在语法，而在形状：顶层是对象还是数组，元素是不是都有同一组键。这条管线把对象数组当作表格，把嵌套对象序列化成单元格文本，把没有键的元素放进合成 `_value` 列——宁可多一列，也不静默丢行。The trouble with JSON is not syntax but shape: whether the top level is an object or an array, and whether its elements share keys. This pipeline treats an array of objects as a table, serialises nested objects into cells, and puts keyless elements in a synthetic `_value` column — a spare column is better than a silently missing row.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 表格类目标要求顶层是数组且至少有一个可落脚的值；空数组与全空对象会明确报错Table targets need a top-level array with at least one value to place; an empty array or an all-empty object fails explicitly
  • 嵌套对象与数组在 CSV / Excel 单元格里变成 JSON 文本，结构化关系不在目标格式里重建Nested objects and arrays become JSON text inside a CSV / Excel cell, and the structure is not rebuilt by the target
  • 文档与图片路线走的是语法着色查看器，不是数据表；键顺序与缩进按渲染结构决定Document and image routes go through a syntax-coloured viewer rather than a table; key order and indentation follow the rendering
  • JSON 里的 HTML 字符串不会被执行：渲染前经过净化，事件属性与脚本被移除HTML strings inside the JSON never execute: the rendering is sanitised, removing event attributes and scripts

常见问题Questions people actually ask

顶层是对象而不是数组，能转 Excel 吗？Can a top-level object, not an array, become Excel?

表格路线要求数组。单个对象没有「行」的概念，转换会报「不是数组」。若对象里包着一个数组，先把它取出来存成 JSON 数组再转。The table route needs an array. A single object has no notion of rows, so the conversion reports that the input is not an array. If an object wraps an array, extract that array into its own JSON file first.

嵌套对象会丢吗？Are nested objects lost?

不会丢，但会变成文本。CSV / Excel 的一格里放不下层级，嵌套值被序列化成 JSON 字符串；需要逐层展开时，转 HTML 查看器或保持 JSON 格式更合适。Not lost, but flattened into text. A CSV / Excel cell cannot hold a hierarchy, so a nested value is serialised as a JSON string. When the levels matter, the HTML viewer or keeping JSON is the better route.

数组里混了字符串和对象怎么办？What if an array mixes strings and objects?

对象按各键成列，没有键的元素写进合成 `_value` 列。若恰好已有同名列，会改用 `_value_2` 之类不冲突的名字——两条数据都保留，不会覆盖。Objects fill their own keys, and elements without keys go into a synthetic `_value` column. If a record already declares that name, a non-conflicting `_value_2` is used — both pieces of data survive.

JSON 转 PDF 后能复制文字吗？Can text be copied out of a JSON to PDF result?

不能。PDF 路线把语法着色后的查看器渲染成页面图像，文字不可选中。需要可复制的文本请选 TXT、HTML 或 Markdown。No. The PDF route renders the syntax-coloured viewer into page images, so the text is not selectable. Choose TXT, HTML or Markdown when it has to stay copyable.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
